name: chevron-down
description: A chevron down with a solid rounded triangular head.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner explicitly requested larger native None glyphs while retaining the existing smaller Square/Circle glyphs unchanged. Single Chevron None has centerline half-width9.125, with20px visible primary width. Other cardinal directions are rigid rotations. None geometry is authored separately from frames, with no runtime style/frame scaling and no scaling of stroke width. Rebuild all Filled contours at the fixed source stroke expansion; never scale a previous Filled path. Square/Circle SVG and metadata files retain their previous exact artwork and dimensions. This supersedes the older requirement that None and framed glyphs have identical size. Native X/Y100/100 and rotation0 remain the new None baseline. Revised None glyph awaits owner review; existing frame review status is unchanged.
